summary.text: Lynn Schulman represents the 29th District on the New York City Council, which includes Rego Park, Forest Hills, Kew Gardens and Richmond Hill in Queens.
Her Council page describes her as an attorney by training and a long-time community and LGBTQ activist.

paragraphs.text: Schulman grew up in Forest Hills, according to her Council page, and held executive positions in government, private industry and the non-profit sector.
She served as Vice-Chair of Community Board 6 for more than 20 years, and was a member of the 112th Precinct Community Council and the board of the Forest Hills Chamber of Commerce.
She was also an appointed member of the Community Education Council for District 28.
She sits on the Committees on Consumer and Worker Protection and on Fire and Emergency Management.
